kind: implementation-loop agent assessment; feature and task verdicts are not human scenario verification
scope: Eight 01a–01h originals. Source → browser-imported MNX → all applicable notation views. Direct desktop task probes use 01a and 01e; other task variants have explicit unresolved/blocked dispositions.
viewPolicy: Originals declare no strings; notation only. Time signatures were explicitly set to Show; effective display options and actual scroller tiles are in each observation.

features.expected: Sharp and flat runs, explicit naturals in bars 25–26, and double sharp / double flat in bar 27 retain their ordinary symbol and note pitch.

features.expected: Four quarter-tone alterations −1.5, −0.5, +0.5, +1.5 occur once in each of two staff registers.
features.sourceDescription: Some microtones: c flat-and-a-half, d half-flat, e half-sharp, f sharp-and-a-half; once in the lower and once in the upper region of the staff.

features.expected: Cautionary/editorial combinations, explicit parentheses off, brackets, parentheses, and bracket-plus-parentheses are distinct around ordinary single/double accidentals.
features.sourceDescription: Accidentals have the attributes ‘cautionary’, ‘editorial’, ‘parenthesized’, and ‘bracketed’. The first two measures each have a cautionary accidental, an editorial, a cautionary with parentheses off, and an editorial and cautionary accidental. The next two measures each have a normal accidental, a bracketed, a parenthesized, and a bracketed and parenthesized accidental.

features.expected: Quarter-flat, sharp, three-quarters-flat and three-quarters-sharp each occur plain, editorial, cautionary, and combined.
features.sourceDescription: Microtone accidentals can be cautionary or editorial. Each measure has a normal accidental, an editorial, a cautionary, and an editiorial and cautionary accidental.

features.expected: Twelve distinct MusicXML 3.1 up/down arrow accidental names are printed on G4, even though the pitch elements have no alter.
features.sourceDescription: Complete range of quartertone accidentals with arrows from MusicXML 3.1: sharp-down, sharp-up, natural-down, natural-up, flat-down, flat-up, double-sharp-down, double-sharp-up, flat-flat-down, flat-flat-up, arrow-down, arrow-up.

features.expected: Fourteen distinct slash, numbered, sori and koron accidental names are printed on G4.
features.sourceDescription: Complete range of Turkish and Persian accidentals from MusicXML 3.1: slash-quarter-sharp, slash-sharp, slash-flat, double-slash-flat, sharp-1, sharp-2, sharp-3, sharp-5, flat-1, flat-2, flat-3, flat-4, sori, and koron.
